checks.rule: Locked PDFs are detected; you enter the password, which is used once in the browser and never stored or logged.
checks.on_fail: Upload pauses until the right password is entered; a wrong password shows an error.

checks.rule: Files of 0 bytes are rejected.
checks.on_fail: Upload stops with a message naming the file.

checks.rule: Pages with no text layer, and PNG / JPG images, are sent to OCR automatically.
checks.on_fail: Not a failure — the page is read by OCR instead.

checks.rule: Before OCR, the browser is checked for background workers, script loading, WebAssembly and in-memory data.
checks.on_fail: Clear error naming what is blocked; digital PDFs, Excel, CSV and text still work.

checks.rule: At least one row with a date and an amount must be recognised.
checks.on_fail: Run stops: “No transaction rows were recognised”.

checks.check: Supported type, size and page limits
checks.result: PDF / image / Excel / CSV / text · ≤ 25 MB · ≤ 300 pages
checks.rule: PDF, PNG / JPG, Excel, CSV or text; ≤ 25 MB per file; ≤ 300 pages per PDF.
checks.on_fail: Upload stops with advice to split or compress the file.

checks.rule: The same file (name + size) selected twice.
checks.on_fail: Second copy skipped; warning shown.

checks.rule: Each page must yield some text after conversion / OCR.
checks.on_fail: Warning listing the blank pages.

checks.rule: OCR confidence per page must be ≥ 60%.
checks.on_fail: Warning listing low-quality pages; expect more review items.

checks.rule: “Page X of Y” footers per file; if absent, dates must not run backwards between pages.
checks.on_fail: Run stops: “Pages appear jumbled” or “Page(s) missing … (missing 3, 4)”.

checks.result: 1 account(s) with number, bank, holder and opening balance
checks.rule: Account number, bank, holder and opening balance for every account.
checks.on_fail: Warning plus a form to fill in the missing details.

checks.check: Transactions inside the stated statement period
checks.rule: Every row date falls within the printed “Statement Period”.
checks.on_fail: Warning: possible merged or edited file.

checks.check: Statement covers the full stated period
checks.rule: Data starts / ends within 10 days of the stated period.
checks.on_fail: Warning: missing weeks can hide income or EMIs.

checks.rule: Previous balance ± amount must equal the printed balance on every row; the balance must be readable on 80%+ of rows.
checks.on_fail: FAILED; decision forced to REFER (possible tampering, or unverified extraction).

checks.result: Reconciles for every account with an opening balance
checks.rule: Per account, opening balance plus all movements must equal the closing balance.
checks.on_fail: FAILED; points to deleted rows or missing pages.

checks.rule: Identical rows (account, date, narration, amount, balance) appearing in two files.
checks.on_fail: Duplicates removed before scoring; warning shown.

checks.result: All dates valid and not in the future
checks.rule: No dates before 2000 or in the future.
checks.on_fail: Bad rows dropped (usually OCR misreads); warning shown.

checks.result: Every row has exactly one of debit or credit
checks.rule: Each row moves money one way: a debit or a credit, not both and not neither.
checks.on_fail: Rows without an amount dropped; rows with both flagged.

checks.rule: No account goes more than 35 days without a transaction.
checks.on_fail: Warning: a missing month can hide a bounce or salary gap.

checks.rule: At least 3 months (75+ days) and 20 transactions.
checks.on_fail: Under 3 months: decision forced to REFER. Under 20 transactions: warning.

checks.rule: All accounts in one currency; foreign card spends noted.
checks.on_fail: Warning: mixed currencies must not be added together.

checks.check: All accounts belong to the same applicant
checks.rule: Holder names across accounts match (joint accounts allowed).
checks.on_fail: Warning: another person’s statement would inflate income.
